content.short: Shyft provides APIs to simplify development on Solana.
content.description: Shyft provides fast, scalable Web3 APIs designed to help teams bring their projects to market quickly and reliably. The service spans Solana, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, and Polygon, giving developers a broad cross-chain toolkit. With Shyft, project founders and developers can integrate core blockchain features—marketplaces, NFT support, token endpoints, and other on-chain functionality—directly into their dapps, simplifying integration while optimizing performance and security.
content.meta: Shyft provides fast Web3 APIs that help projects launch faster and more efficiently. Discover Shyft and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
